profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced software tech lead with a focus on robust platform development. I've led sensor integration projects (camera, imu, gnss, lidar, radar, v2x), tracked down linux kernel bugs, scaled up vehicle configuration management and much more.

positions.title: Engineering Manager, Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
I led the team responsible for platform software development on advanced development and production vehicles. 

Building and shipping impactful solutions for middleware, sensor platform, and data collection.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on vehicle software platform for automated driving.

Building high performance messaging middleware, cloud apps & integrations, sensor drivers, kernel profiling & optimization, and more.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed automotive infotainment using C++ and Qt 5 on Windows, Linux, and more.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed infotainment integration for voice recognition, steering wheel controls, and phone app on multiple Honda vehicles. Used C++, Qt 5, and Java on Android 5 and 6.
